title: bin_column: bucket numeric values into intervals
description: Create a new column by binning a numeric column into intervals. Use this for ranges such as low/medium/high, age bands, or amount buckets.

parameters.name: new_column
parameters.description: Name of the new binned column.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Optional labels. Must have len(bins)-1 values.

parameters.name: include_lowest
parameters.description: Whether the first interval includes the lowest value.

rag_note: Ask for clarification when the user asks to bucket values but does not provide boundaries or clear labels.
